steps.en: Add the curated sheets preset to your web app
steps.zh: 给 Web 应用装上精选的表格 preset

steps.en: Mount the preset on a container div in your page
steps.zh: 把 preset 挂到页面上的容器 div

steps.en: Open an empty workbook through the Facade API
steps.zh: 通过 Facade API 开一个空工作簿

steps.en: Renders the grid, toolbar and formula bar on one canvas
steps.zh: 在一块 Canvas 上画出网格、工具栏与公式栏

steps.en: Evaluates every cell edit through its formula engine
steps.zh: 每次单元格编辑都过一遍公式引擎求值

steps.en: Same packages run headless in Node for server-side work
steps.zh: 同一套包在 Node 里无头跑服务端计算

value.en: You ship an Excel-like editor inside your product without writing a canvas engine, a formula parser, or an undo system
value.zh: 你在产品里交付了一个类 Excel 编辑器，却一行 Canvas 引擎、公式解析或撤销系统都不用写
